title: Executive Order 14371: Providing for the Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on Dec…
summary: Executive Order 14371, "Providing for the Closing of Executive Departments and Agencies of the Federal Government on December 24, 2025, and December 26, 2025", was signed on 2025-12-18 and published in the Federal Register on 2025-12-23 (90 FR 60545).
